snippet.title: CURSE RETOLD (Early Access) - Launch Trailer // Hello Neighbor 1 Mod
snippet.description:
AFTER 3 YEARS OF HARD WORK, EARLY ACCESS IS FINALLY HERE

Curse Retold (before known as Fatal Peek) is a complete reimagining of Hello Neighbor 1, drawing heavily from the modern lore and atmosphere while adding a touch of nostalgic charm from the beloved alpha versions. Play in randomized houses against Theodore Masters Peterson, who will do everything in his power to stop you from involving yourself in whatever lies within Raven Brooks.

Early Access used to contain Chapter 1 of STORY MODE & Act 1 of ESCAPE MODE.
The Beta Release has been launched in January 2026, featuring QoL improvements, bug fixes, reworks, and Escape Mode Act 2, concluding the entire arc presented in Early Access.

DOWNLOAD: https://www.moddb.com/mods/hello-neighbor-curse-retold/downloads/curse-retold-official

Created by Fatal Peek Team
Trailer by EKC_Dev
#HelloNeighbor #Mod #CurseRetold
